extracted_information: The provided web content is an introductory page for Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) on Microsoft Learn. It defines WMI as the infrastructure for management data and operations on Windows-based operating systems, applicable to enterprise applications and administrative scripts. While it doesn't contain direct C# code examples, it provides specific guidance and a link for C# and .NET Framework developers.

features.name: WMI Definition
features.description: Infrastructure for management data and operations on Windows-based operating systems. Automates administrative tasks on remote computers and supplies management data to other OS parts/products (e.g., System Center Operations Manager, Windows Remote Management).

features.name: Target Audience
